description: Agent Access: submit a listing of your service on someone else’s directory or registry (the directory, the listing page, the endpoint it sends agents to, the network, version, tool or endpoint count and status, and when it was read) and the live service’s own facts (the endpoints it serves, the endpoints it has retired, the networks it settles on, its version, count and status). The signed report gives every field as match, mismatch or unstated and names every field that would send an agent to the wrong place: a retired or unserved endpoint, a wrong network such as a retired test network, and a live listing for a retired or offline service, then every stale version, count or status, with the correction to request from the directory. Listings on Wever’s own surfaces are wever_listing-check, wever_directory-listing-check and wever_catalog-listing-check, and an offer’s price and terms across every discovery surface are wever_discovery-coverage-check. Verdict misdirects_agents, stale_listing, listing_unverified or matches_live. POST /api/external-listing-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-access-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-access/.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

directory.description: The directory or registry that holds the listing.

endpoint.description: The endpoint the listing sends agents to.

read_on.description: When the listing was read, as a date.

endpoints.description: The endpoints the service serves now.

networks.description: Networks the service settles on now.

retired_endpoints.description: Endpoints the service no longer serves.
